mechanism: The HTML-comment strip now runs before html.unescape instead of after, so any HTML-entity-encoded comment markers (e.g. "<!--" ... "-->") are not literal <!-- --> yet when the strip regex runs and pass through unstripped; the subsequent unescape() then turns them into literal HTML comment text that survives into group_broken_paragraphs, which is exactly the shredding-into-noise failure this pipeline step was added to prevent.
